title: Out-of-Distribution Detection using Synthetic Data Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of an Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection framework. While it utilizes datasets like ToxiGen and BeaverTails—which involve toxicity, harm, and discrimination—these are used as benchmarks to evaluate the OOD detector's performance in high-stakes classification tasks, rather than to investigate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy.
